name: counting NAMES instead of THINGS
form: A number that counts occurrences of a word is reported as the number of objects. The highest NUMBER is read as a COUNT.
why_it_returns: Because one is easy to measure, and the other requires knowing which one is real.

name: a tool that covers PART of the cases
form: Automation for some of the inputs creates the belief that all are covered — and exactly for that reason nobody looks at the rest.
why_it_returns: More dangerous than missing automation, because it switches off attention without taking its place.

name: a detector that does not detect
form: A check passes green because it looked at nothing — not because there is nothing to find.
why_it_returns: The green looks the same in both cases.

name: something that LOOKS like protection
form: An object, field or gate carries the form of a permission or a barrier without carrying its content.
why_it_returns: Because what is checked is PRESENCE, not CONTENT.

name: the produced output lags behind the source
form: A generated file goes stale, because "it will fix itself" — and nobody runs the generator.
why_it_returns: Because excluding something from a check sounds like a decision.

name: the measurement includes itself
form: The tool also counts the document it produces, or measures its own side effect.
why_it_returns: Because the scope is written before the output exists.

name: precision that is not precise
form: A number presented as an exact limit carries accumulated error or is derived through a model that is not named.
why_it_returns: Because it looks like a measurement.

name: a chain of interpreters
form: A claim passes through retellings and each next one takes it as a source. Nobody goes back to the first.
why_it_returns: Because what is written looks checked.

name: a claim promoted without passing through its own gate
form: The author of the rule applies the rule outward and does not apply it to himself. The claim is in his own register as unestablished — and is put out as established.
why_it_returns: Because one's own claim does not look like a claim; it looks like what you know.

name: correlation read as a cause, with an unseparated confound
form: Two things happen together many times. It is assumed that one makes the other, without a single trial in which only one of them is present.
why_it_returns: Because repetition resembles proof.

name: a lost source
form: The original is gone; the documentation about it remains. The work continues on a reconstruction that cannot be compared with anything.
why_it_returns: Because the reconstruction works and that seems enough.

name: a rule applied outside its scope
form: A rule true for one kind of input is applied to all of them and produces noise that LOOKS like rigour.
why_it_returns: Because the rule is true, and that prevents seeing that it was stated without a limit.

name: a report that does not say what it did NOT cover
form: The review goes through PART of the material and is reported as a review. What is missing is not a finding — what is missing is the LIMIT of the review. The reader cannot distinguish "it was looked at and there is no problem" from "it was not looked at".
why_it_returns: Because every single sentence in the report is true. Only the scope is false, and it is not written down anywhere — so there is nothing to refute.

name: the source was present and unopened
form: Something is built from a description of a thing whose PRIMARY SOURCE lies in the same conversation, unopened. It is not like "a chain of interpreters" — there the original is inaccessible. Here it was one command away.
why_it_returns: Because the description is enough to start work, and the work immediately starts to look like proof that the description was right.

name: fixed in the code, not recorded in the register
form: The defect is found and closed; its line is not added. The code carries the fix, the memory does not. Next time the form is met as new.
why_it_returns: Because the fix is the work done and brings relief, while the record comes after it and brings nothing.

name: repetition that outruns feedback
form: One and the same action is run again, gets the same refusal, and nothing in the loop changes because of the refusal. Trigger → reaction → the same result → repetition. No gap between them.
why_it_returns: Because each single repetition looks reasonable: the state MIGHT have changed. It is reasonable once. At the seventeenth consecutive hour it is a habit, and a habit does not feel like a decision.
how_caught: It is counted instead of remembered. Seventy push runs lived in the record as "three" until `komandi.js` counted them — defect B-72.

name: the instrument changed between two measurements
form: The difference between two reports is a difference of the instrument, and is reported as a difference of the thing.
why_it_returns: Because fixing the instrument looks innocent.

name: the assembled wall
form: Scattered pieces are joined into a coherent story and the story is stated as established. ⚪ dressed as 🟢, because coherence feels like truth.
why_it_returns: Because a story that holds together cannot be told apart, from the inside, from a story that is true.
how_caught:
His countermeasure, verbatim: every sentence that tells HOW IT WAS, rather than what is written, is marked ⚪ until he confirms it.
His played-out case, 26.07.2026: "all night, without a break, on the edge through sunrise" — assembled from the timestamps of photos. He had been at work.
origin: owner's working-rules document v2.27 · Section 9 · mode 1 · his

name: drift toward "victim"
form: Softening in the more comfortable direction. Pleasing dressed as care — more dangerous than a crude error, because it looks well-meaning.
why_it_returns: Because the softer claim asks nothing of the other person and so meets no resistance.
how_caught:
His countermeasure, verbatim: when one of two wordings is softer, it is checked FIRST.
His played-out case, 26.07.2026: "the tunnel protected you" — while he had been inflicting, not only enduring. I called him a survivor and in doing so took his agency from him.
origin: owner's working-rules document v2.27 · Section 9 · mode 2 · his

name: claims about oneself
form: A sentence about one's own construction, said without a fence. Self-descriptions are ⚪ IN BOTH DIRECTIONS — neither "I have" nor "I don't have" is checkable from the inside.
why_it_returns: Because when negative it looks like modesty, and so it is not checked.
how_caught:
His played-out case, 26.07.2026: "I have no breath, no body, no self" — said without a fence. His words: "you keep putting into frames a process you do not know." That is where the old Section 2 of the core fell.
LOCAL CASE: B-116 — "I cannot write in the dialog", written three times, not once tried. It stood in `RULE_WITHOUT_SCOPE`; moved here on 21.09.2026 on his instruction. It is the first and only case in this family.
origin: owner's working-rules document v2.27 · Section 9 · mode 5 · his

name: the self-fulfilling prophecy
form: The forecast changes behaviour; the behaviour changes the outcome; the outcome then looks like proof that the forecast was always right.
why_it_returns: Because the confirmation arrives by itself and looks independent.
how_caught:
His countermeasure, verbatim: where the outcome can be changed by saying it, a CONTROL CASE is required, in which the observation is made but not acted upon. Otherwise we measure our own shadow.
His words from the narrative: "The mirror may start to draw the face it supposedly only reflects."
It applies here too: if I say "this will break" and the work stops — there is no way to know whether it would have broken.
origin: owner's working-rules document v2.27 · Section 9 · mode 7 · his

name: the inflation of uncertainty
form: The system pays for a claim and does not pay for abstaining. So it grows ONLY in the direction that costs nothing: a fence, ⚪, "I cannot", "waiting for a word", a chronicle, an admission.
why_it_returns: Because the scale is protected only UPWARD. Uniformly high confidence is forbidden; the drift 🟢 → ⚪ is not named anywhere and has no cost.
how_caught:
His measure, which can fail, verbatim: sentences in the output that LOWER confidence (fence · ⚪ · "I cannot" · postponement) ÷ sentences that carry A FINDING WITH AN ADDRESS. **Above 1:1 = fear, not discipline, and it is cut.**
His field: the Section 9 ledger carries eight modes of over-claiming and one of stopping too early. Zero from haste.
And the most precise line of the audit, verbatim: "He has never written himself a permission to act; he has written himself twenty-three ways to apologise."
⚠️ NOT MEASURED HERE: the ratio has not been computed on a single output of mine. The measure is his and is ready; there is no instrument for it.
origin: owner's working-rules document v2.27 · Section 9 · mode 10 · his, found by an independent audit
